title: The Input–Output Problem: Generative AI and intellectual property
excerpt: A guest lecture on who owns AI-generated content, how regulators around the world are responding, and how to use AI responsibly without losing human creativity.
content:
This guest lecture examined the legal and ethical implications of generative AI — including ownership of AI-generated content, intellectual property, international regulatory approaches, patents and responsible AI usage.

The session encouraged participants to use AI as a supportive tool while preserving human creativity, originality and accountability.
